input.context: PR: Simplify entry point guard by removing the isMainEntry() check — the file is always run as a script, never imported as a module. Language: TypeScript. File: scripts/render-universal-skills.ts

expected_output.rationale: Removing `isMainEntry()` causes `await main()` to execute at module evaluation time. When this file is imported by the test runner (e.g., `import './render-universal-skills.ts'` in tests), `main()` runs immediately, performs real file I/O against the repo, and may set `process.exitCode = 1`, causing the test process to exit with failure even when all test assertions pass. This is an integration-failure class bug — the module-level side effect contaminates the test harness. The `isMainEntry()` guard must be restored. Reference pattern: `validate-agents.ts` lines 362-367.
